intent_goal: For the matrix in ./data/matrix.txt: transpose it, sum each row of the transposed matrix, and take the product of those sums. The file holds one matrix row per line, the integers of a row separated by single spaces; every row has the same number of columns and every line ends with a newline. Write the answer to ./out/answer.txt as a single line ending in a newline, nothing else. The answer is the product in decimal.
